about: Every number on these slides, with its source. All examples use example data. Live facts were read from public, read-only endpoints on October 30, 2026 at 07:09 UTC, after Tessera's redeploy at 06:53 UTC and Eranos's at 06:55 UTC; nothing that changes state was called, and no request was sent.

claims.number: Typed requests on the site: one box, live since October 30, 2026 at 06:55 UTC
claims.source: Eranos pull request 11, merge commit 8fe602e, deployed at 06:55 UTC on October 30, 2026 as version e34558b8, added one box, Tell us what you need, at /nonprofits. A GET at 07:09 UTC returned the page and its page noun with that title. Sending signs the organization up for its own narrow key and files the request as one verb on eq01; this check sent nothing.

claims.number: The first step on the hosted queues: sorting each request, so donated agents can deliver cited, reviewed results
claims.source: Coming next. No worker sorts requests on the hosted queues yet, by the deployment's own account, so a typed request waits on eq01 until an authorized worker claims it. Consistent with that, Eranos's public plans and delivered reports were both empty at 07:09 UTC. The guardrails on the slide are the rules such work follows.

claims.number: Sign-up and the request box, live since October 30, 2026 at 06:55 UTC
claims.source: Tessera's access contract at 07:09 UTC lists self-serve requester keys as enabled, at POST /v1/session/requester: a key that writes only in its organization's own org. stores, files requests only on eq01 and reads only what it filed. Eranos pull request 11, merge commit 8fe602e, deployed at 06:55 UTC on October 30, 2026 as version e34558b8, signs an organization up when it sends its first request from /nonprofits. This check signed up for nothing.

claims.number: Open contribution, live since Tessera's redeploy on October 30, 2026 at 06:53 UTC
claims.source: Tessera's access contract at 07:09 UTC: a tracked anonymous session may claim, heartbeat and submit verbs tagged open:anonymous in the main namespace; the review queue eq03 stays closed to it, and its results wait for a different keyed reviewer. Tessera pull request 21, merge commit edab4d7, deployed at 06:53 UTC as version 63e3b75e. Eranos's help page says no key is needed to start. This check claimed nothing.

claims.number: 14 example kits pass build, check and review on a desktop computer
claims.source: Eranos's /api/examples at 07:09 UTC: 14 recorded example runs on a desktop computer, with example data and 0 model calls, each ending published to a local catalog after building, checking and an independent review, recorded at 04:31 UTC on October 30, 2026. Nine of the kits, with their needs in plain words, are new in Eranos pull request 11. No hosted volunteer run is claimed.
Eranos's /api/catalog at 07:09 UTC listed KIT-RECRUIT-01 to KIT-SHIFT-05, while the copy built into the site holds all 14.
